ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-gray pixels dominate approx. 75% of the surface area, with low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle and along the distal perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark-intensity isosceles-triangular region extending from the base to the notch. Large contiguous high-intensity zones across the lateral lobes. Dark-pixel fringe mapping the entire trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approx. 52 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude jagged peaks (approx 15-20 pixels in depth) concentrated on the right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the proximal-anterior edge transitioning to a sharp tapering at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark-intensity clusters (barnacle colonies) located at both lateral tips. A distinct circular high-contrast ring-shaped scar is visible on the medial-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous low-intensity diagonal linear pixel-disruptions across both light-colored lobes. Two prominent horizontal high-intensity (white) linear marks are visible on the dark-intensity peduncle surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Macro-scale biological attachments (barnacles) visible as dark jagged clusters on the outer tips. Horizontal traumatic scars on the peduncle. Prominent circular lesion/scar on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tips exhibit highly irregular, multi-pointed jagged morphology significantly deviating from the linear trailing edge profile.
